name: Yes Optoelectronics (Group) Co., Ltd.
summary: Specializing in the design, manufacturing, and global sales of a wide array of liquid crystal display (LCD) products, Yes Optoelectronics (Group) Co., Ltd. operates across Europe, the United States, Japan, and Korea. The company's comprehensive product lineup features standard LCD panels, various module types such as COG, TAB, COB, and SMT, alongside TFT displays. Furthermore, they provide LED, OEM services, shutter LCDs, and E-INK display solutions. Founded in 2012, the enterprise, initially known as Yes Optoelectronics Co.,Ltd., officially rebranded to Yes Optoelectronics (Group) Co., Ltd. in February 2021. Its operational base is situated in Anshan City, China.
